data.standardized_narrative: The 2012 year of account, a prior year, ran off satisfactorily with a steady release of longstanding reserves due to favorable claims development and the resolution of open items through negotiation or litigation. For the current 2014 year of account, reserves were strengthened primarily for major litigation items and adjustments to reinsurance balances, particularly within the CCI book and for disputed items in the UK, Italy, and USA, which were subject to adverse legal developments.
